name: Command menu
description: A keyboard-first command menu with grouped actions, subsequence matching, a gliding highlight and a live result count.
scope: Grouped action list, subsequence matching with highlighted matches, gliding selection indicator, arrow keys, Escape to clear, Enter to run, live count and announcement.

name: Async combobox
description: A debounced city search that guards against stale responses, glides a highlight across results and confirms the selection with its timezone.
scope: 260ms debounce, stale-response ticket guard, gliding highlight, match highlighting, keyboard selection, timezone confirmation panel, clear control.

name: Inline editor
description: An inline title editor with explicit save and cancel, live character counting and a visible change history.
scope: Edit in place, live 60-character counter, inline required error, Enter to save, Escape to discard, saved change history.

name: Step form
description: A three-step wizard with a connector-linked stepper, per-step validation that blocks advancement and a review panel built from entered values.
scope: Stepper with connector fill, per-step validation, radio group, preserved values when moving backwards, review panel.

name: Validation summary
description: A form-error summary that links every issue to its field, counts validity live and clears as fields are fixed.
scope: aria-invalid per field, linked error list that focuses its field, live validity pill, shake on failed submit.

name: Tag editor
description: A chip input with suggestions, duplicate detection, a six-label cap and Backspace-to-edit on the last chip.
scope: Enter or button to add, suggestions, duplicate warning, six-tag cap, Backspace edits the last chip, animated removal.

name: File drop zone
description: A drag-and-drop file picker with type and size validation, an animated drop target and a fill bar on acceptance.
scope: Drag-over state with ring animation, extension and 100 KB checks, rejection messaging that resets the input, remove control.

name: Verification code
description: A six-slot verification code input with paste-spread, arrow-key navigation, a resend timer and per-slot confirmation.
scope: Paste spreads across slots, digits only, Backspace walks back, arrow keys move, resend resets, verified state.

name: Date range picker
description: A month calendar with Monday-first weekday headers, a hover preview band between the two dates and inclusive night counting.
scope: Monday-first weekday grid, hover preview band, inclusive night count, end-before-start normalisation, clear.

name: Filter bar
description: A multi-select filter bar with live counts, removable active chips and a clear-all control.
scope: Multi-select with counts, removal chips, clear all, empty state, announcement of visible count.

name: Navigation drawer
description: A slide-in drawer with a blurred scrim, focus trapping, Escape to close and focus restored to the trigger.
scope: Slide-in with scrim, focus trap, Escape, focus restoration, current-page marking.

name: Nested menu
description: A flyout menu with a pointer arrow, roving arrow-key focus, a danger action and Escape-to-close with focus return.
scope: Flyout with pointer, roving focus, Home/End, Escape and ArrowLeft close with focus return, danger styling on Share.

name: Overflow tabs
description: A scrollable tab strip with a gliding underline, Home/End and arrow-key roving focus, and a fade that signals hidden tabs.
scope: Gliding underline, roving tabindex, Home/End, arrow keys, scroll fade, right-scroll control, per-tab panel content.

name: Breadcrumb trail
description: A breadcrumb trail that collapses the middle segments behind a control and expands them back, keeping the current page marked.
scope: Ellipsis expands two hidden segments and collapses them again, focus moves to the revealed crumb.

name: Reading outline
description: A scroll-spy outline with a progress rail that tracks position through the reading pane.
scope: Scroll spy with aria-current, progress rail, click-to-scroll, reduced-motion aware.

name: Pagination controls
description: Numbered pagination with a windowed page list, ellipsis, disabled bounds and a live range readout.
scope: Windowed page numbers with ellipsis, disabled previous and next at bounds, live range.

name: Collapsible tree
description: A keyboard-navigable file tree with guide lines, expand and collapse on arrow keys, and selection.
scope: role=tree with aria-expanded, arrow-key navigation, indent guides, selection.

name: Data table
description: A sortable revenue table with row selection that survives sorting, an animated bulk-action bar and a search empty state.
scope: Column sorting with direction indicator, selection persisted across sorts, select all with indeterminate state, bulk bar, search empty state.

name: Virtual list
description: A windowed ten-thousand-row audit log that renders only the visible slice while keeping the full scroll height.
scope: 10,000 records, fixed row height, aria-posinset and aria-setsize, jump to top.

name: Kanban lanes
description: Three drag-and-drop lanes with live counts, add-task controls and moves announced to assistive technology.
scope: Native drag-and-drop across lanes, add task, live counts, announcements.

name: Activity timeline
description: A grouped activity rail with typed markers, quoted comments and progressive loading.
scope: Type filters, progressive load more, quoted comments, typed markers.

name: Schedule calendar
description: A month calendar with correct Monday-first date placement, weekday headers, an event marker, and a range band with inclusive night counts.
scope: Correct weekday placement, adjacent-month days, today marker, event dots, range selection with hover band.

name: Comparison grid
description: A feature comparison with an accessible only-differences switch and distinct check and cross marks.
scope: Accessible switch, check and cross marks, difference emphasis, live count.

name: Status dashboard
description: A live metrics panel with trend badges, an outage simulation and a bar sparkline.
scope: Metric rows with trend badges, outage toggle that stops showing stale values as current, sparkline bars.

name: Toast stack
description: Severity-coded toasts with icons, a draining timer bar, pause-on-hover and a three-item cap.
scope: Four severities with icons, draining timer, pause on hover and focus, dismiss, three-item cap, empty state.

name: Action confirmation
description: A real modal dialog with a scrim, focus trap, Escape to cancel, and an undo bar with a countdown.
scope: Modal with scrim and focus trap, Escape cancels, confirm removes with an undo countdown.

name: Progress steps
description: A numbered stepper with ticked completions, connector fill, per-step panels and review.
scope: Numbered bubbles with ticks, connector fill, per-step panel, review summary, start over.

name: Notification center
description: A notification inbox with unread emphasis, correct singular/plural copy, an unread filter and an empty state.
scope: Unread emphasis, mark one read, unread filter, mark all read, empty state, correct pluralisation.

name: Repository map
description: A proposed read-only tool that summarizes a repository's folders and entry points.
scope: Bounded file discovery, ignored paths, source citations, and no code execution.

name: Change risk review
description: A proposed assistant that identifies likely impact areas in a pull-request diff.
scope: Diff-size limits, affected-path summary, evidence links, and uncertainty labels.

name: Test gap finder
description: A proposed diff reviewer that highlights changed behavior without nearby tests.
scope: Map changed files to tests, report gaps with paths, and avoid invented coverage claims.

name: Dependency impact
description: A proposed read-only dependency map for spotting consumers of changed modules.
scope: Static import graph, bounded traversal, cycle handling, and explicit unknown edges.

name: License notice check
description: A proposed inventory of declared licenses and bundled attribution files.
scope: Report file-level evidence and missing notices without giving legal conclusions.

name: Documentation freshness
description: A proposed checker for documentation references that no longer match repository files.
scope: Validate local paths and commands against source files; flag ambiguous references for review.

name: API contract diff
description: A proposed comparison of two API schemas with emphasis on breaking changes.
scope: Schema-size limits, route/field changes, citations, and versioned output.

name: Accessibility review
description: A proposed checklist assistant that ties UI findings to observable markup.
scope: Evidence from supplied HTML, keyboard-flow checklist, and no claim of a full audit.

name: Release checklist
description: A proposed release checklist assembled from repository configuration and changes.
scope: Read-only evidence, human sign-off steps, and explicit unverified checks.

name: Build log triage
description: A proposed parser that groups build failures by likely root cause.
scope: Log truncation, secret redaction, grouped errors, and references to exact lines.

name: Issue similarity
description: A proposed helper for finding possibly related issues without merging them automatically.
scope: Similarity scoring, evidence snippets, and human confirmation before action.

name: Prompt boundary probe
description: A proposed offline test harness for known prompt-injection boundary cases.
scope: Fixture-based inputs, pass/fail criteria, no secret-bearing targets, and reproducible reports.

name: Secret pattern audit
description: A proposed local scanner that flags likely credential strings without printing them.
scope: Allowlisted file types, false-positive controls, masked output, and no external upload.

name: Localization consistency
description: A proposed comparison of translation keys, placeholders, and missing locale entries.
scope: Key-set diff, placeholder matching, source references, and no invented translations.
